== Summary ==
Crop of one slip, with the label printed above it, from the Players Committee printable ''Virtual Cards: Master List'' (Dark Side), cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built 3 February 2014), '''PDF page 15''' (middle column, bottom slip). The label above the slip reads "•Ysanne Isard"; the card's face prints "•Ysanne Isard"; the margin reads "Swilla Corey (V)". The same card was first printed on the Virtual Block 7.1 sheet (2010) as "•Ice-Heart" (see [[:File:VB7-03-Ysanne_Isard.png]]).

Source: [[:File:Virtual Legacy Final Master DS.pdf]], page 15 ([https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/33/Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf#page=15 wiki copy]). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=15 Internet Archive, 4 July 2017].

Edits: rendered at 300 dpi with pdftoppm and cropped (PDF points x 212–400, y 436.5–702 from the top left); nothing else changed. Art on the card: "Original Image courtesy of www.hydraworx.net", as printed.

Used on [[Virtual cards#How the sheet labels vary]], [[Ysanne Isard (Virtual Block 7)]].
